India Sells LIC Stake, Prompting Share Price Drop; LEAP India IPO Announced

The Indian government initiated the sale of up to 6.5% of its stake in Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) of India through an Offer for Sale (OFS), setting a floor price of ₹382 per share. The sale, aimed at raising over ₹300 billion (approximately $3.6 billion), opened for institutional investors on August 4 and for retail investors on August 5. Following the announcement and the opening of the OFS, LIC's share price dropped by approximately 8%. Concurrently, logistics firm LEAP India, backed by KKR, announced its Initial Public Offering (IPO) with a price band of ₹151-159 per share, aiming to raise ₹480 crore in fresh equity and ₹2,000 crore from existing shareholders, with subscription opening on August 7.
